name: Gipfelrestaurant Nebelhorn
kurzbeschreibung: **Nebelhorn Summit Restaurant in Tirol** Discover breathtaking views from the **Nebelhorn**—the highest mountain in the **Lechquellengebirge**—at this iconic **Gipfelrestaurant**. Perched at **2,224 meters**, it offers panoramic vistas of the **Alps**, **Tirol**, and beyond. Savor traditional **Tiroler** specialties like hearty **Kaiserschmarrn**, savory **Gröstl**, or freshly baked **Apfelstrudel**, paired with local **Bier** or **Schnaps**. Enjoy the cozy alpine atmosphere with a warm **Glühwein** or a refreshing **Radler** on sunny days. A must-visit for hikers, families, and food lovers—accessible by cable car from **Oberstdorf** or **Feldberg**. Open year-round, with seasonal dishes and festive charm during winter holidays. **Plan your visit** and experience **Tirol** at its finest!
